omron.upside: Bittensor subnet 2 token up 24% this week on a 255x trading surge; code pushed 3 days ago.
omron.cheap: No dated catalyst found; surge may be a subnet-wide TAO move, and the website is down.
omron.wrongIf: The price gives back the week's gain within days or the website stays down past Oct 31.
omron.vsScanner: Scanner sees momentum; I see a dead website and no news.

prometeus.upside: Korean listings (Upbit Aug 12, Bithumb Aug 24) already happened; no October event found.
prometeus.cheap: Listing hype already priced and faded: -15% on the week.
prometeus.vsScanner: The 'new listing' badge is two months old.

puffer-finance.upside: Upbit KRW listing went live Oct 15, a verified, dated event; Bithumb/Coinone also trade it.
puffer-finance.cheap: Korean retail just found it, but +70% in a week means the news is mostly priced.
puffer-finance.wrongIf: The Upbit volume fades and price returns under $0.025 within two weeks.
puffer-finance.vsScanner: Listing is real this time, but I won't chase a +70% spike.

elympics.upside: Gaming platform with code pushed 5 days ago.
elympics.cheap: Only 46% of tokens released; tiny volume.

apex-5.upside: Bittensor subnet 1 with active code, flat on the week.

flamewire.upside: Bittensor subnet with code 25 days old.
flamewire.cheap: Down 15% on the week with no news found.
flamewire.wrongIf: Stops code updates for another month.
flamewire.vsScanner: Scanner score is momentum-based; nothing behind it that I can verify.

cyberconnect.cheap: Listing date not verified; 48x below ATH.
cyberconnect.wrongIf: Bitbank listing not confirmed as recent.

radicle.upside: Kraken listing claim; I found no dated announcement.
radicle.wrongIf: No Kraken announcement dated in the last 30 days.

bedrock-token.upside: Near recent high (ATH Sep 2026) in a DeFi token.

brevis.upside: Active infrastructure project, code pushed yesterday.

meta-2-2.upside: Governance token near its ATH (2x away).

inverse-finance.wrongIf: Volume returns to normal without news.
inverse-finance.vsScanner: Spike without a reason is not a catalyst.

aleo.upside: Up about 130% since late September (about $0.022 then); I could not find the reason.
aleo.cheap: Chasing a spike with no found news.
aleo.wrongIf: Gives back the gain, falling under $0.03.
aleo.vsScanner: Scanner warns it is late; I agree.

debridge.upside: Bridge with active code; closest to ATH (2.9x).

topPicksNote: Only verified catalyst (Puffer/Upbit Oct 15) already ran +70% this week; nothing else has a dated event.
